intro: Twin Peaks is the sports-lodge restaurant chain known for its ice-cold 29-degree draft beer and a scratch-made menu of wings, smash burgers, chicken sandwiches, flatbreads and smokehouse ribs, served across big screens for game day. It leans casual and shareable, with a long list of starters and a full bar. Below is the full Twin Peaks food menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: A Twin Peaks cheeseburger is about $10.29 and the loaded Billionaire's Bacon Burger is $13.29. Six boneless wings are $9.79, a chicken sandwich is $11.29, flatbreads run about $12, and a half rack of ribs is $14.79. The 29-degree draft beer, wings and smash burgers are the draw. Portions are shareable.
hot_deal: Twin Peaks value: Happy Hour and game-day specials on the 29-degree draft beers and shareable starters are the draw, and weekday lunch combos run cheaper. Wings by the dozen and the burgers (from about $10.29) feed a hungry table. The full bar means it is more a night-out spot than a quick bite. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Twin Peaks known for?
faqs.a: Twin Peaks is a sports-lodge restaurant known for its ice-cold 29-degree draft beer, scratch-made wings, smash burgers, flatbreads and smokehouse ribs, all served across big screens for game day. It is a night-out sports bar more than a quick-service spot.

faqs.q: How much is a burger at Twin Peaks?
faqs.a: A cheeseburger is about $10.29, the Avocado Smash Burger is $11.29, and the loaded Billionaire's Bacon Burger is $13.29, all served with fries. Chicken sandwiches are around $11.29 and flatbreads about $12.

faqs.q: What is 29-degree beer at Twin Peaks?
faqs.a: Twin Peaks serves its draft beer at 29 degrees Fahrenheit, colder than standard, which the chain markets as its signature ice-cold pour. It is a big part of the Twin Peaks sports-bar experience alongside the food.

faqs.q: Does Twin Peaks publish nutrition information?
faqs.a: Twin Peaks is a sports-bar restaurant and does not publish a full nutrition table, so calorie figures are not listed here. The menu leans toward hearty, shareable pub food, so lighter options are limited.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Twin Peaks?
faqs.a: The best known are the wings, the smash burgers, the Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich, the Sweet n' Smoky ribs, and the flatbreads, all paired with the 29-degree draft beer.
